user.title: TAGO Bus Location
user.description: Enter the general service key from data.go.kr. You must apply for both 'TAGO bus location' and 'TAGO bus route' APIs. Either the Decoding or Encoding key works.

city.title: City and route
city.description: Choose a city and enter the route number.

route.title: Select route {route_no}
route.description: Found {count} route(s) numbered {route_no}. Select the ones to show. If each direction is registered separately, select both.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid service key. New keys can take 1-2 hours to activate, and both the bus route and bus location APIs must be approved.

init.title: Polling
init.description: Shorter intervals use more of your daily quota. Polling slows to every 5 minutes automatically while no bus is running.
